At the Company’s Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on October 28, 2026 (the “Annual Meeting”), Jean Bua, Gerard J. DeMuro, and Scott Ostfeld were elected as Class II Directors for a three-year term ending in 2029. Item 5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders. The final voting results for the Annual Meeting are as follows: 1. On October 28, 2026, in connection with the Annual Meeting, the Company’s Board of Directors held a meeting at which it elected William L. Ballhaus as Chairman of the Board, Barry R. Nearhos as Lead Independent Director, and determined the composition of the Board committees for the upcoming year. The committees of the Board will be constituted as follows: Audit Committee: Barry R. Nearhos, Chair; Jean Bua; Lisa S. Disbrow; and Debora A. Plunkett Government Relations Committee: Lisa S.
